evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp to add the listrawtransactions RPC method.
rationale: Adds the `listrawtransactions` RPC to resolve issue #34632 where transactions lacking external counterparties (such as self-transfers and consolidations) were invisible in `listtransactions`. It gives users and downstream applications a clear way to inspect all wallet transactions without change suppression, fulfilling a concrete feature request.
